_readme: TALENTS and how you earn them.
costs[] is indexed by CURRENT level: costs[0] is the price of the first
purchase, costs[1] the second, and so on. The array LENGTH is the max level —
there is no separate 'max' field to keep in sync. Want 5 hand slots? Five
numbers. Want the 4th to cost 20? Type 20.
draftSteps — lifetime ⭐ thresholds. Crossing one grants a pick-1-of-3 draft.
Stars are score, not a wallet: they are never spent.
